name: Knox County, NE
findings: Knox County has 31 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Knox County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
